title: Wrinkles galore!
text: Wrinkles galore!. This is a very soft and reasonably well made bed skirt, but after washing and taking immediately out of the dryer, you could tell is was made of cotton as it was badly wrinkled. It took a quick iron and lays nicely. It does the trick of hiding the under-bed stash. It will take a stiff cotton blend to avoid wrinkles.

product_metadata.title: Sheets & Beyond Wrap Around Solid Microfiber Luxury Hotel Quality Fabric Bedroom Gathered Ruffled Bedding Bed Skirt 14 Inch Drop (Queen, Yellow)
features: Queen Size Bed Skirt Measures 60" x 80" + 14"
description: Dress your bed in luxury and quality with The Sheets & Beyond Gathered Bed Skirt. This bed Skirt features 14-inch drop that conceals your box spring and bed frame, creating a tidy, unified and contemporary look. Its long length coupled with smooth clear appearance covers your bed perfectly. Also the mitered corners and side pleats bring elegance and style to your bedding décor.
